title: 7-Day Rolling Average of Daily Submissions
prompt: The K-12 homework app tracks when students submit assignments each day. Write a query that computes a 7-day rolling average of daily submission counts, ordered by date ascending. For each date in the `daily_submissions` table, calculate the average number of submissions over that date and the 6 preceding days (up to 7 days total). Dates at the start of the dataset will average over fewer than 7 days if there aren't enough prior records. The output should have columns `submission_date` and `rolling_avg_submissions` (rounded to 2 decimal places). Use an explicit window frame clause with `ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE daily_submissions (submission_date DATE NOT NULL, submission_count INTEGER NOT NULL);

composite_moves: time-window: order by date, apply ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW frame for AVG aggregate

hints: You need a window function that computes an average over a moving set of rows.
Use AVG() OVER with an ORDER BY on the date column and a ROWS BETWEEN frame clause.
The frame should include the current row and the 6 preceding rows: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW. Round the result to 2 decimal places.
answer_key: SELECT submission_date, ROUND(AVG(submission_count) OVER (ORDER BY submission_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rolling_avg_submissions FROM daily_submissions ORDER BY submission_date;

_meta.scenario: a K-12 homework app tracking assignment turn-in and grade improvement
